title: Google's Free AI Hunts Black Friday Deals for You 🛍️
description:
Google's free AI shopping tools can do the hard part of Black Friday for you: describe someone in AI Mode or the Gemini app to get gift ideas with reviews, check if a price is low, typical or high, tap Track price for a drop alert, and point Google Lens at a store shelf to see reviews. Availability of some shopping features varies by country.
Full AI news every Sunday: AI News This Week on our channel.

What are you buying this Black Friday? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop: Free AI Tool #2 drops next Tuesday.

Source: Google, "How to find the best Black Friday deals and shop smarter" (November 16, 2026) + Google Help, "About price tracking on Google" + 9to5Google on Google price tracking

#AItools #AInews #Shorts #BlackFriday #Google
